english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something physically damaged, broken, or torn.

examples.english: This paper is damaged, so don't use it again.
examples.traditional: 呢張紙爛咗，唔好再用喇。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 zi2 laan6 zo2 m4 hou2 zoi3 jung6 laa3

english.note: Use 爛 as the all-purpose choice for food or other materials that have physically decayed.

examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 ping4 gwo2 laan6 zo2
